about_short_description.short_description: Ontra provides urban areas and transit agencies with the tools to enhance ridership.

product.name: Rider Application
product.description: A mobile and web app for passengers to plan and use bus, shuttle, and paratransit services.

product.name: Driver Application
product.description: A mobile app for transit drivers to manage and operate bus, shuttle, and paratransit services.

product.name: Dashboard, Analysis, and Admin Tools
product.description: A set of tools for transit agencies to monitor, analyze, and administer transit operations.

product.name: Algorithmic Dispatching
product.description: A system that automates the scheduling and dispatching of transit vehicles based on algorithms.

product.name: Managed GTFS and GTFS-RT
product.description: A service that manages and updates transit schedule and real-time data feeds in GTFS and GTFS-RT formats.

product.name: Automated Reporting
product.description: A system that generates reports on transit operations and performance automatically.
